text:
Noa (People Ops): Quick heads-up: we've pushed three small handbook updates (clarified parental leave for variable-hour roles, added a documented flexible-work approval flow, and adjusted PTO carryover language). Publish date is next Monday. Please review and ensure your teams complete the single 12-min micro-course by Nov 14. Tracker + manager checklist in the sheet.

Hana (Legal): Read and approved. I replaced "immediate family" with a short enumerated list to avoid cross-jurisdiction confusion and added a note for region-specific statutory differences.

Olli (Recruiting): We'll need to patch offer templates for part-time language. For offers already accepted, are we grandfathering?

Noa (People Ops): Yes 1: changes are not retroactive. Added that line to the confluence note. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/handbook/nov-2026-clarifications. Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/nov-handbook-ack

Kai (Benefits): Noted the PTO carryover tweak  max carryover reduced for non-exempt employees; added an FAQ entry about anniversary calculations in the sheet.

Bea (Eng Manager): Can managers bulk-acknowledge after verifying team completion? Also want a short script for 1:1s with converting contractors.

Noa (People Ops): Yes, bulk ack allowed after verification. Manager script and a 2-slide deck are uploaded under "Manager assets" in the sheet. There's also a column to request a 15-min manager walkthrough if needed.

Hana (Legal): I put a short FAQ blurb about contractor conversions and stipend timing in the sheet. Useful to remind managers about offer-date vs start-date distinctions.

Bea (Eng Manager): Great. How will we track completions? I have a few ICs on variable schedules.

Noa (People Ops): LMS captures completions. Managers get an email summary and can request a CSV export from the tracker under "Exports". We'll run daily exports and support ad-hoc requests.

notify-bot: Reminder scheduled: employees missing training will receive nudges on Nov 1, Nov 8, and final on Nov 13 (status: queued).

Kai (Benefits): Quick ask: add a note on phased return after parental leave and how benefit enrollment windows work for conversions. I'll drop exact wording in the sheet.

Noa (People Ops): Please do. Final ask: managers, confirm in the tracker by Nov 18 that you've reviewed with your teams. If anyone needs a private walkthrough, drop a time in the sheet or reply here. Thanks all :raised_hands:
__notes: Single Slack thread: handbook clarifications, manager checklist, training deadline, tracker links, and export process. Messages are chronological and prefixed by sender names.
